conflicts.description: Many files are modified or untracked before this planning session. Some are likely unrelated report/print work.
conflicts.strategy: Before executing any task, capture git status and restrict edits to the specific task's files. Do not stage with git add .
conflicts.impact: Prevents overwriting parallel work and keeps audit fixes reviewable.

conflicts.description: Backend calculation uses positive deduction magnitudes, while Excel/display may use signed negative cells. Mixing these creates -(-amount) defects.
conflicts.strategy: Establish an invariant document and add tests for both positive and negative source inputs across payroll, tax, payslip, and exports.
conflicts.impact: Reduces payroll validity risk and avoids future regressions.

conflicts.description: Formula logic appears in backend services, frontend aggregators, Excel exporters, tax pages, and payslips.
conflicts.strategy: Audit all formula sites first; only consolidate where an existing shared helper already exists or a small adapter can remove real duplication.
conflicts.impact: Avoids creating a large abstraction while still eliminating dangerous inconsistencies.
